response.text: The data dictionary has a few claims to check. The DESCR for GLJRNH.SRC_REF says it's a user name, but it holds an invoice number for AP journals. Also, the sign convention and the status-code claims need checking, so I'll run a few more queries.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'AP_inv_jrnl_link' chk, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN i."JRNL_NO" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nulls FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_unbalanced', COUNT(*), 0 FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" GROUP BY "JRNL_NO" HAVING ROUND(SUM("DR_AMT"),2)<>ROUND(SUM("CR_AMT"),2)) x UNION ALL SELECT 'lines_both_or_neither_side', COUNT(*), 0 FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE ("DR_AMT"<>0 AND "CR_AMT"<>0) OR ("DR_AMT"=0 AND "CR_AMT"=0) UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_amounts_gljrnl', COUNT(*), 0 FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "DR_AMT"<0 OR "CR_AMT"<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_inv_amt', COUNT(*), 0 FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_pay_amt', COUNT(*), 0 FROM "APPAYM" WHERE "PAY_AMT"<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_gljrnl_acct', COUNT(*), 0 FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_inv_vend', COUNT(*), 0 FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APVEND" v ON v."VEND_CD"=i."VEND_CD" WHERE v."VEND_CD" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_pay_inv', COUNT(*), 0 FROM "APPAYM" p LEFT JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."INV_ID"=p."INV_ID" WHERE i."INV_ID" IS NULL;

SELECT i."STAT_CD", COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(i."INV_AMT"),2) inv_total, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.paid,0)),2) paid_total, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.paid,0) >= i."INV_AMT" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) fully_paid_cnt FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN (SELECT "INV_ID", SUM("PAY_AMT") paid FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY "INV_ID") p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."STAT_CD";

SELECT h."POST_FLG", h."SRC_CD", h."PRD_ID", COUNT(*) n, MIN(h."POST_DT") min_dt, MAX(h."POST_DT") max_dt, SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(h."POST_DT")<>8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad_len FROM "GLJRNH" h GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3,2;
